Card Q&A.a: Yes, different Digimon can be chosen.
Card Q&A.q: Can different Digimon be chosen for the target digivolution cards to trash and the target digivolution cards that "can't attack or block" for this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
When this card's [When Digivolving] effect is activated on an opponent's Digimon with 4 digivolution cards, is it possible to trash the 1st and 3rd digivolution cards from the top?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash any 2 digivolution cards under 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until the end of your opponent's turn.
